provenance.construction: Rotated toric code on the periodic 2x2 lattice: all plaquette checks, (i+j) even -> X; distance 2 (cycle lengths).
provenance.notes: Rotated surface/toric ladder fill: standard topological configuration, distance exact by construction (a row or column of plaquettes is a weight-d logical; none lighter exists). Staged for review; novelty vs the wider literature unverified beyond the cited family origin.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil flagged interleaved two-block extraction (max_flags=2 per check, 5 data CX slots per round, X-check term slots [1, 3, 4, 2], Z-check term slots [3, 1, 0, 2] over terms A_0..A_1, B_0..B_1); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)
